helpDraw: d                        deal one card to each of the four piles
helpRemove: rm                       discard all four when their ranks match
helpMove: mv <col>                 stack onto the leftmost pile showing that rank
helpRedeal: rd                       gather and re-deal once the stock is spent (no limit)
hintRemove: Hint: the four exposed cards match — discard them with rm
hintMove: Hint: stack col{{col}} onto the pile to its left showing the same rank
hintDraw: Hint: deal one card to each pile
hintRedeal: Hint: the stock is spent — gather and re-deal with rd
hintReasonRemove: Why: all four exposed cards share a rank, so they come off together.
hintReasonMove: Why: stacking reduces the exposed cards and improves the odds of a match.
hintReasonDraw: Why: no move is available, so deal one card to each pile.
hintReasonRedeal: Why: the stock is empty, but the table can be gathered and re-dealt (no limit).
markerLegend: Markers: * = all four match, discardable / > = stacks onto the same rank at its left
loopDetected: The same board keeps returning — there is no further progress
helpExampleHint: h                         ask for the next move
